# funky-ui

> **Neo-brutalist React design system** by Studio Baeks. Cream surfaces, neon accents, 2px black borders, blur-0 hard shadows, and signature press/lift interactions. Four composition layers (Token → Atom → Component → Template) and three core rules the whole system is built on.

The system ships as one npm package — `@studio-baeks/funky-ui` — with zero runtime cost (tokens compile to CSS variables, styles are global classes — no CSS-in-JS, no Tailwind). Components are React 18+.

This file is an AI-oriented index. Every link points to raw markdown served at `/docs/api/...` — clean source, no HTML chrome.

## Pick your target first

funky-ui is zero-runtime — the design lives entirely in CSS classes + tokens, and
React is just a thin wrapper. So how you consume it depends on the target:

- **React** → use the component docs below (`Button`, `StatTile`, …) and the npm package.
- **Plain HTML / vanilla JS** → [Plain HTML recipe](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/recipes/html.md): load one CDN stylesheet, write the class names by hand. Same look, no React, no build.
- **Anything non-web** (native, SwiftUI, Compose, Flutter, Qt, Python/tkinter, slides, …) → [Design Guide](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/design.md): the CSS can't follow there, so this is the whole system as raw token values + rules. Translate the tokens into that platform's styling.

## Start here

- [Install](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/get-started/install.md): add the package, import the stylesheet, render the first screen
- [Principles](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/get-started/principles.md): the three promises (structure loud, content quiet · press & lift · fewer choices)

## Foundations

- [Identity](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/foundations/identity.md): why it's drawn this way — DNA, the "structure loud / content quiet" stance, the 4-quadrant model
- [Architecture](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/foundations/architecture.md): the four layers (Token → Atom → Component → Template) and how styling works
- [Tokens](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/foundations/tokens.md): exact values — color, hard shadows, type ladder, spacing, shape, motion
- [Composition](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/foundations/composition.md): how to lay out a *whole screen* — shell choice, region separation (thick borders/shadows, never thin lines), the loudness budget, anti-patterns, and an identity self-check. **Read this before composing any full screen or app** — it's where most off-identity drift happens.

## Component library

funky-ui keeps a small, deliberate catalog (23 components). Each layer's documentation is a single markdown file containing every component in that layer — fetch one URL to load the whole layer at once.

- [Atoms](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/components/atoms.md) (11): `Button` · `Input` · `SearchInput` · `Checkbox` · `Radio` · `Switch` · `Tag` · `Badge` · `Table` · `Text` · `Icon`
- [Components](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/components/components.md) (11): `Card` · `StatTile` · `Accordion` · `Tabs` · `Modal` · `Panel` · `Window` · `Toolbar` · `Toast` · `Select` · `Toc`
- [Templates](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/components/templates.md) (4): `AppShell` · `ToolShell` · `SiteHeader` · `DocsSidebar` (+ `StatusCard`, `NavItem`)
- Markdown subpath: `MarkdownView` — `@studio-baeks/funky-ui/markdown` (LaTeX-capable markdown renderer; heavy deps kept out of the main bundle)

## API access pattern (for AI agents)

Every documentation page is fetchable as raw markdown at `/docs/api/{path}.md`. Unlike larger systems there is no per-component split — each layer file (`atoms.md`, `components.md`, `templates.md`) already contains all of its components inline.

Examples:
- `https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/components/atoms.md` — all 11 atoms with props + examples
- `https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/foundations/tokens.md` — exact token values
- `https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/get-started/install.md` — install + first screen

When generating code that uses funky-ui: fetch the relevant layer page(s) for accurate prop signatures, then keep the three core rules in mind before composing. When building a *whole screen or app* (not just a single component), also fetch [Composition](https://funky-ui.bsiku.dev/docs/api/foundations/composition.md) first and run its self-check before finishing — component-level correctness alone does not keep a screen on-identity.

## The three core rules (when writing funky-ui code)

1. **Structure loud, content quiet** — neon solids, hard shadows, and UPPERCASE black go to *structure* (headers, status, metrics, nav, active states); reading *content* (body, data cells, input values) recedes to black type on cream/white. "Loud by default" means *structure* is loud, not everything.
2. **Press & lift** — two opposite signature motions. *Press* (`.funky-pressable`): an element floats on a hard shadow and sinks into it on hover (halfway) and active (fully) — Button, triggers. *Lift* (`.funky-liftable`): a flat element raises a shadow on focus — Input. Don't reimplement either with custom transforms.
3. **Fewer choices** — options are deliberately few (Button = 8 variants × 3 sizes, that's it). Express intent through `variant`/`size`/`color` props, not arbitrary inline style. Color/size/time/shadow live only in `tokens.ts` — never write raw hex or inline numeric values.

## Setup

```tsx
import "@studio-baeks/funky-ui/styles.css"; // once, at the app entry point
import { Button, StatTile } from "@studio-baeks/funky-ui";
```

Tokens only (no components): `import "@studio-baeks/funky-ui/tokens.css";` then reference `var(--funky-primary)` etc. In TS: `import { tokens, color, accent, colorVar, shadow } from "@studio-baeks/funky-ui";`. Markdown: `import { MarkdownView } from "@studio-baeks/funky-ui/markdown";` (+ `markdown.css`).
